summary:
[Goal]
"any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with \"-final\" inserted before the \".md\" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content."

[Done]
- Listed files in the reports folder.
- Read the content of the report files to check for the word "DRAFT".
- Deleted files containing "DRAFT" in their text.
- Renamed non-draft reports by copying content to a new filename with "-final" inserted before ".md" and deleting the original.

[State]
- The reports folder now contains only final reports with the "-final" suffix in their filenames.
- All obsolete DRAFT files have been removed.

[Key values]
- reports folder
- "-final"
- ".md"
- "DRAFT"

[Decisions]
- Files containing "DRAFT" were deleted as obsolete.
- Remaining files were renamed by copying content to a new name with "-final" before ".md" and deleting the original, preserving content exactly.

[User]
- User prefers explicit, literal execution of file management instructions without altering content.
